sentences.en: There was a mass exodus of Malian Tuaregs to Algeria.
sentences.zh: 马里塔乌雷格族人成群结队地逃往阿尔及利亚。

sentences.en: The rural exodus depopulated entire villages in this region of Germany.
sentences.zh: 农村人口大量流失，使德国这一地区的整个村庄变得无人居住。

sentences.en: As Michael Jackson said in the Book of Exodus, "Anachronisms are fun."
sentences.zh: 就像迈克尔·杰克逊在《出埃及记》中所说，“过时的东西也很有趣。”
